name: nuget-compass
description: NuGet for VS Code, with target framework filtering that actually works.

nuget-compass.updateLevel.description: How aggressively to suggest updates. 'patch' = same major.minor; 'minor' = same major; 'major' = any newer version.

nuget-compass.includePrerelease.description: Include prerelease versions when listing available updates.

nuget-compass.tfmFilter.description: Target framework filter. 'compatible' hides versions that don't target your project's framework; 'all' shows every version with incompatibility marked.

nuget-compass.showTransitive.description: Show transitive dependencies in the package list.

nuget-compass.dotnetPath.description: Optional path to the dotnet executable. Empty = auto-detect from PATH.

nuget-compass.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for individual NuGet API requests, in milliseconds.

nuget-compass.dotnetCommandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for `dotnet package list` and related subprocess calls, in milliseconds. Increase if scans of large solutions or projects with many ProjectReferences time out.

nuget-compass.maxConcurrentCatalogReques.description: Maximum concurrent NuGet catalog API requests.

nuget-compass.trace.description: Verbose logging of subprocess invocations and HTTP requests to the output channel.

nuget-compass.fontScale.description: Scale factor applied to text in the NuGet Compass panel, on top of the built-in base size. 1 = default; 1.2 = 20% larger; 0.9 = 10% smaller. Useful on high-DPI displays.
